notes.title: The Girl of Glass: A Summer Bird's Tale Soundtrack is here!
notes.notes:
Dear Citizens,

We are proud to present the original game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1413380/The_Girl_of_Glass_A_Summer_Birds_Tale_Soundtrack/]soundtrack for The Girl of Glass: A Summer Bird’s Tale[/url], composed and produced by Fredrik Jonasson. 

The musical journey includes 18 tracks ranging from calming orchestral and piano music to the bombastic combat tracks, and of course the main theme sung by Marie Nilsson Lannerö. As a bonus, you will also find alternative versions of tracks that were not intended for the official release of the soundtrack!

The soundtrack is available in both high-res mp3 files and lossless FLAC files.

May his beak guide you,
The Sheriff

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 is here!
notes.notes:
Dear Citizens,

Our wise engineers have just uploaded an all-new patch 1.0.4. It includes:

* Tweaks to make it more clear which direction the pawn will move in combat when using the Switch/Move ability.
* Some difficulty tweaks to combat scenarios.
* Bugfixes.

Enjoy the improved version of The Girl of Glass: A Summer Bird's Tale and may he take you under his wings,

The Sheriff

notes.title: New changes in Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Dear Citizens,

We have mande another change for the easiest diffictulty setting. Build 1.0.3. makes fights quicker and easier. Changes were made to health bar and the AI of the opponents. Player health bar was increased.

May he take you under his wings,
The Sheriff

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is here!
notes.notes:
Dear Citizens,

We would like to report that thanks to your valuable feedback we've managed to repair some issues that you've brought to our attention.

Our talented team of engineers has come up with some quick solutions to the following nuisances:

1. Softlock -Fixed freeze bug when losing against wasps.
2. Running - Increased double-click interval to make it easier to tell Kristal to run.
3. Difficulty - The Easiest difficulty (in the second half of the game) is now easier.
4. Ringmaster's Keys - Fixed bug where ringmaster's keys would not be obtained in very rare cases. For those affected, the keys will now appear in the inventory.
5. Mouse click - Fixed a bug where mouse click commands would occassionally overlap and cause unexpected behavior.

Thank you for your continuous effort to make our world better.

May he take you under his wings,
The Sheriff

notes.title: The Girl of Glass: A Summer Bird’s Tale
notes.notes:
Join Kristal, a girl of glass, who begins her journey into the unknown. Help her navigate a path to self-discovery and fight alongside a cast of companions to save her homeland from an evil tyrant Eagle.

[b]The Girl of Glass: A Summer Bird’s Tale[/b] is a point-and-click adventure game with beautiful hand-drawn graphics and turn-based combat that will test your wits. It tells the story of a fragile girl, who decides to leave everything behind on a whim with a boy she had just met. That is when everything takes an unexpected turn.

“The fate of glass is to break” — will she escape it?

If you wish to discuss [b]The Girl Of Glass: A Summer Bird's Tale[/b] and become a part of our community, please join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1203750/discussions/]Steam forum[/url].
